notes: Proof House application contracts for Sepolia, deployed in constructor dependency order from the accepted source. ArtStorage stores artwork; ArtHouse manages collections and sales; KeyProof verifies wrapped-key proofs; ArtifactsPiece is the locked implementation used by ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource for independent one-token ERC-721 contracts. ARTIFACTS has a fixed maximum supply of 256: 255 editions named ARTIFACTS #NNN and ARTIFACTS · THE SOURCE, minted only upon purchase and claim or auction settlement. ArtHouse's immutable IMD is the existing Sepolia IMD ERC-20 (0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a, 'Identity.md (test)', 18 decimals), the address README.md and script/Deploy.s.sol name for this chain and the one launch 1656 used; the mainnet IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) has no code on Sepolia, where it would make mintWithIMD revert forever. IMD is an existing ERC-20 payment option for plain SVG collections. No fungible token or pool is deployed. ArtStorage, ArtHouse, ArtifactsFactory and ArtifactsSource receive $owner explicitly and use two-step ownership without renunciation. BrokerPass offers at most 100 free ERC-721 passes, claimable with an ARTIFACTS piece or an identity.md seat (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d, the only identity.md seat collection, on Ethereum mainnet; no Sepolia seat contract is published), once per wallet and once per qualifying NFT. On Sepolia that address has no code, so the seat-only paths (BrokerPass.claimWithSeat, SubmissionReviews.reviewAsSeat) revert there and seats cannot qualify; every piece-holder path works, and the owner-set holders gate (setGate) tolerates a code-less seats address, treating nobody as a seat holder. SubmissionReviews provides advisory reviews by seat and claimed piece holders, frozen when the curator decides a submission. No upgradeability, deployment ETH funding or post-deployment calls are included. The owner configures the application afterwards.
